## The learning path

| # | Module | You will learn to… |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | [FASTQ → consensus genome](course/01-concepts.qmd) | read FASTQ files, do QC, map reads, inspect coverage, build a consensus and decide if it is usable |
| 2 | [Alignment, lineage & reference selection](course/02-reference-selection.qmd) | choose a reference, align genomes, assign a lineage |
| 3 | [Build and read a phylogenetic tree](course/03-build-tree.qmd) | infer a tree, root it, read clades, support and branch lengths |


Module 1 is the 3-hour bridge session (talk + dry lab); modules 2–3 are Day 4 (phylogenetics) and modules 4–5 are Day 5 (capstone).

## How to work

1. Do the [setup](exercises/00_setup.md) once.
2. Follow the pages in the order of the left menu; each exercise ends with a question to discuss.
3. Fill in your answer sheet and, on Day 5, your one-page brief.
